The main takeaway from our work is that
the SRAM design process can be significantly improved through the use of a body-contacted sensing-scheme and a dynamic-leakage suppression scheme.
a combination of two-stage sensing, body-contacting and dynamic leakage suppression can reduce total power consumption by 60% with no increase in access time.
